Lunenburg County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Simple Guide

Interested in purchasing properties through tax sales in Lunenburg County, Virginia? This guide provides a straightforward overview to help you navigate the process.​

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

Understanding Tax Sales in Lunenburg County

Lunenburg County conducts tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These sales offer opportunities for individuals to acquire properties, often at favorable prices.​

Key Details About Lunenburg County Tax Sales

  • Schedule: Tax sales occur as needed, without a fixed annual date.​
  • Auction Time: Auctions typically begin at 11:00 AM Eastern Time.​
  • Registration: Mandatory for all participants.​
  • Registration Period: Varies per auction; consult the official auction notice for exact dates.​
  • Location: Usually held at the Lunenburg County Circuit Courthouse, 11435 Courthouse Road.​
  • Redemption Period: Property owners can settle their debts to reclaim their property any time before the auction.​
  • Bidding Process:
    • Properties go to the highest bidder.​
    • Deposit and full payment terms are specified in the auction notice.​
    • Properties are sold “as-is,” so thorough research is essential.​

    • Email: info@lunenburgva.gov​
